unresolved.reason: Sources consistently identify the limited retail box by GN-06017, but this research did not independently verify the Sony printed/internal serial on the game disc inside that box. GN-06017 should therefore be treated as the limited product/package code, not automatically as a disc serial.

The researched console release is PS2. Sources describe the underlying original _summer as a Windows title and _summer## as its PS2 console port; no additional platform currently represented in RegionAtlas was found for this same console release.
